name: field-security-isolation-audit
objective: تنفيذ مراجعة أمنية عدائية لكل field-related object/surface/API مع object authorization وIDOR/cross-field/cross-store/replay/upload/PII/finance/audit كامل.
truthOwner: Identity plus each domain backend own authorization; Control Panel/mobile UI never substitutes server enforcement.

tasks.objective: Red-team all field-causal security boundaries and remove every proven bypass/overexposure from the authoritative layer.
tasks.currentProblem: New/changed assignments, drafts, documents, messages, publication, offline and finance paths expand object authorization and audit surface; UI-only checks would be insufficient.
tasks.requiredChange: Build negative matrix by object/actor/store/operator role, test direct APIs/list/search/deep-links/cache/replay/uploads/finance approvals, then fix root auth/data exposure and add regression tests.
tasks.targetState: Every field object is least-privilege and fail-closed; unauthorized actors receive no sensitive existence/data; all sensitive mutations and finance approvals are auditable.
tasks.action: Enumerate endpoints/readers/writers and Control Panel pages/tabs from U002-U011, execute adversarial tests, correlate CodeQL/security signals where applicable, and remove stale aliases/bypasses/overbroad queries discovered.
mustNotChange: لا expose existence/PII/financial identifiers beyond need.
لا broad admin shortcut لتجاوز object scope.
لا إدخال unrelated app security work.
acceptanceCriteria: Field A cannot list/read/mutate Field B objects بأي مسار.
finance maker/checker and destination data least-privilege/audited.
كل Control Panel page/tab ميدانية تمر نفس route/object permission model.
tasks.rollback: Security fixes use forward-fix; never restore a bypass to regain compatibility.
tasks.commitBoundary: Security hardening changes grouped by shared root cause only.
